mode: implementor; writes limited to tools/impl-08.sh + this fragment + results/qrun-08.json + results/qrun-08-selftest.tsv; tool mutations confined to mktemp fixture repos (/tmp/souji08-selftest.*) via the fixture-root rail; live fleet touched read-only only (git log/status/for-each-ref/rev-parse, rg, stat); no fetch/push/commit/branch on any live repo; no secret-shaped reads; .ufo/state and .ufo/watchdog.log not opened

deliverable.language: bash (bash + coreutils + git + rg only, lane substrate rule)

cli.plan: plan [--json] [--stale-days N] [--root REPO] <path>... (read-only; TICKET rows AUTHORIZED|NOT-AUTHORIZED)
cli.stage: stage [--hold-seconds N] [--operator-token T] <path>... (mutating, rail-gated; STAGED/REFUSED rows; exit 1 on any refusal)
cli.check: check --repo REPO --ticket ID (read-only second receipt check after hold; exit 1 on FAIL)
cli.delete: delete --repo REPO --ticket ID [--operator-token T] (mutating, escape-guarded; DELETED/REFUSED)
cli.runbook: runbook [--json] <path>... (read-only; GATE rows naming the operator-owned action that opens each blocked gate)

deliverable.exit_codes: plan/runbook 0 always (evaluated clean); stage 0 ok / 1 refused; check/delete 0 ok / 1 refused-or-failed / 2 usage; selftest 0/1; usage 2

flow_mapping.source: census/round-7/quarantine-plan.json execution_plan_template (step_0_recheck..step_4_delete) + SKILL.md removal flow + AGENTS.md receipt/hold/signoff rules
flow_mapping.step_0_recheck: plan re-derives gate1 (git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline -- <path> empty), gate2 (status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all -- <path> empty), gate3 (tools/souji-verify.sh verdict SAFE with non-none receipt; inline pushed/stale fallback ONLY when that tool is absent). stage re-runs ALL gates before any write
flow_mapping.step_1_stage: plain mv (never git mv, never commit) to <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<UTC-date>/<rel with / -> __>; append-only manifest.tsv (ticket, date, orig, receipt, sha256, stage_epoch/iso, hold_seconds, status, qpath) + journal.log; ticket id q<utc>-<pid>-<rand>
flow_mapping.step_2_hold: hold floor 450s for pushed, 86400s otherwise (SKILL.md 'prefer 24h for anything not pushed' encoded as the non-pushed default); --hold-seconds applies in full only to /tmp fixture repos — live repos get max(default, N) (fail-closed)
flow_mapping.step_3_second_check: check enforces: hold elapsed; staged copy digest equals manifest sha (tamper caught, copy preserved); original path NOT recreated (concurrency); zero unpushed commits with committer-time > stage_epoch touching the original path (lane woke up); receipt re-derived from pinned manifest (pushed: recorded intro still ancestor of resolved default ref; stale: zero live references) — history-based re-derivation, never engine-on-copy, so the quarantine deletion being uncommitted cannot false-break and cannot false-pass
flow_mapping.step_4_delete: delete requires status=second-checked + hold elapsed; realpath escape guard resolves the rm target to <qc>/<single-date-dir>/<basename> and refuses crafted manifest dates ('..' → date-dir-guard) and traversal basenames (can only resolve inside the date dir); rm strictly inside .ufo-quarantine; manifest status -> deleted + journal

authorization_rail.rule: stage/check/delete on a repo whose root is outside /tmp are REFUSED before any filesystem effect unless env SOUJI_OPERATOR_TOKEN is set AND --operator-token matches (operator sign-off). Live refusals journal ONLY if <repo>/.ufo-quarantine already exists — round rule 'no live-lane writes' respected even on the refusal path
authorization_rail.fixture_evidence: selftest T10: stage of $LANE_ROOT/LOG.md refused (stage-denied, gates: g1=10) and ls -d $LANE_ROOT/.ufo-quarantine -> absent; delete on $LANE_ROOT with env token + mismatching flag -> operator-token-mismatch, lane still untouched
authorization_rail.note: on /tmp fixture repos the rail is inert by design (the sandbox is the authorization); the token path is exercised against the live lane precisely because refusal is its only possible outcome this round

design_divergences_from_peers.gate3_engine: single-engine (tools/souji-verify.sh, installed behavior wins per SKILL.md) + inline fail-closed fallback; S02 requires both engines. Parent adjudication should pick one; switching my gate3 to dual-engine is a ~10-line change in verify_receipt
design_divergences_from_peers.second_check: never runs an engine on the quarantined copy; re-derives from the pinned manifest (history-based). This dodges final-22's second_check_semantics trap by construction (staging never commits, so the copy has no intro commit to mis-read); matches the S10 four-line procedure form the judge endorsed
design_divergences_from_peers.cli_shape: subcommand style (plan/stage/check/delete/runbook) with TSV grammar mirroring souji-verify.spec.md; S02 uses flag modes, impl-01 repo-anchored flow. Same multiple-CLI situation the judges flagged for adjudication; outcomes agree on every probe

defects_found_and_fixed_during_developme: bash case-pattern parser break on mixed quote-concatenated globs (bashed parse surfaced lines away from cause) — replaced with grep -F assertions
owning_repo passed an existing FILE to git -C (needs a directory) -> every repo lookup empty; fixed to dir-vs-dirname branch
verify_receipt read column 1 as the verdict; souji-verify grammar is VERDICT<TAB>path<TAB>SAFE<TAB>receipt<TAB>evidence -> column 3
default_ref double-prefixed origin/ (for-each-ref short name already carries origin/) and counted the origin/HEAD symref as a branch ref -> both fixed; exactly-one-branch rule preserved
expected-failure commands under set -e aborted the selftest harness -> rc captured via || rc=$?
trap referenced function-local WORK after scope exit -> globalized
refusal paths journaled unconditionally -> guarded to journal only where .ufo-quarantine already exists (round rule: no live-lane writes even on refusal)
mutation_allowed printf missing its repo argument

known_limits.metadata_prune: out of scope for staging (file/dir artifacts only); plan surfaces gate evidence on the owning repo and runbook prints the opening action — matches r7's finding that registrations retire via worktree tooling, not mv
known_limits.obsidian_receipt: delegated to souji-verify.sh when present; inline fallback refuses it (fail-closed, receipt-unverifiable)
known_limits.inline_stale_branch: effectively unreachable through the gated flow (a committed scratch file verifies as pushed first; an untracked one fails gate2) — kept as defense-in-depth, documented honestly
known_limits.ignored_paths: gate2-invisible to git status (same caveat S02 recorded); manifest + second check + operator signoff bound the exposure
